title: Digital DATCOM Forces and Moments
text: Compute aerodynamic forces and moments using Digital DATCOM static and dynamic stability derivatives, 10 inputs, 2 outputs, {Units} sets Units Metric; {Digital DATCOM structure} sets the digital DATCOM data structure factstruct1, {Force axes} sets the coordinate system for aerodynamic force, {Interpolation method}, {Extrapolation method}, {Process out-of-range input} sets the handle out-of-range input Clip and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Aerodynamic forces at the center of gravity three-element vector

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Aerodynamic moments at the center of gravity three-element vector

params.name: Units
params.values: Units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Digital DATCOM structure
params.values: Digital DATCOM data structure factstruct{1} (default) | structure

params.name: Force axes
params.values: Coordinate system for aerodynamic force Body (default) | Wind

params.name: Process out-of-range input
params.values: Handle out-of-range input Clip to Range (default) | Linear Extrapolation

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error
